question.question:
A constant-product pool holds 11000 token A and 150000 stablecoins (1 USD each). Direction sell_a: sell_a inputs A, buy_a inputs stablecoins; the other is output. Gross input is 3 percent of the pre-trade input reserve. A 25 basis point fee on gross input is deducted first; only net input enters the invariant, but the full gross input stays in the pool, so the post-trade input reserve includes it. Pre-trade spot is stablecoin reserve over A reserve; effective price is gross USD per A traded; price impact in percent is effective over spot, minus 1, times 100 (signed). Benchmark is spot times one plus -12.5 percent (signed). Signed result (gain positive): sell_a, USD out minus gross A in times benchmark; buy_a, A out times benchmark minus USD in. What is the signed result in USD?

Answer format: use exact arithmetic through all intermediate steps, round only the final value half up to 2 decimal digits, and return only the numeric value interpreted in `usd` with no unit label or additional text.

slots.description: Units of the output token received after the fee-adjusted invariant swap
Post-trade reserve of the input token including the retained fee
Signed price impact of effective price versus pre-trade spot, in percent
